$comment: Single source of truth for the projects shown on tor2dbear.com. Add a project here and it appears on the front page; the new-project script appends to it automatically. The front page no longer renders `color` — the cards are deliberately monochrome — but it is kept in step with roadmap/sources.json, which does use it, so a project reads the same on the board.
